hooks.command: git -c 'alias.guard=!IFS=; f=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/guard.sh; test -f $f || f=.claude/hooks/guard.sh; test -f $f || exit 0; sh $f; test $? = 42 && exit 2; exit 0' guard

git -c 'alias.cloudstart=!IFS=; test x$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE = xtrue || exit 0; f=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/cloud-start.sh; test -f $f || f=.claude/hooks/cloud-start.sh; test -f $f || exit 0; sh $f; exit 0' cloudstart
